I can’t access or inspect your PDF, so I can’t read page 34 to extract the exact basis‑point change — please upload page 34 or give the two margin percentages; otherwise use this one‑sentence template and replace [XXX] with the exact number from the chart:

"Segment margin improved by [XXX] basis points year‑over‑year (an increase of [Y.YY] percentage points), driven primarily by [primary driver]."

Note: to get [XXX], subtract last year’s margin from this year’s margin and multiply the percentage‑point difference by 100 (1 percentage point = 100 basis points). I cannot verify the chart’s values without seeing it.
